items.statement: The investigation records candidate generation, deduplication, coverage and an outcome-based stopping rule for both channels.
items.expected_result: The report preserves per-candidate identities and explains why the search was complete or bounded.

items.statement: A claimed transition state is validated by stationary-point convergence, exactly one imaginary frequency and a channel-consistent displacement.

items.statement: The reported reference barriers are approximately 23.5 kcal/mol for [3,3] and 26.2 kcal/mol for [5,5].
items.expected_result: Successful independent results identify both channels and report values near the source barriers; bounded failure is acceptable only with documented attempts.

items.statement: For 3a, the double-boat [3,3] barrier is lower than the [5,5] barrier; the paper attributes the low barriers to cyclopropyl strain and favorable polyene positioning.
items.expected_result: The final comparison gives the ordering and confines the mechanistic interpretation to evidence-supported scope.
